name: Portrait kiosk cart open
describe: Cart bar expanded (cartExpanded): the lines block grows above the footer, max-h-[50vh] (960 px) with border-b and p-4; each line is the item name and a 32 px round bordered − / + stepper pair with the quantity between (gap-3).

Use after the guest taps the count/total button. The footer keeps the count/total toggle (aria-expanded) and Checkout. RTL is a kit extension (the source has no dir handling): the kit mirrors with logical properties and translates the fixed UI labels (self-order has no locale file).
